prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity design exploration board for MAJLIS Telegram Mini App, inspired by iOS 27 Liquid Glass. No device hardware, no perspective, no hands. Neutral pale gray presentation backdrop. Small board title "01 / CLEAR" and subtitle "MAJLIS · Концепция интерфейса". Small footer "Пример данных". Direction: restrained Apple-native precision, cool porcelain white, grouped inset surfaces with 26px continuous corners, deep graphite text, MAJLIS saturated cobalt blue accents, translucent frosted-glass FLOATING navigation and toolbar only, opaque readable content, subtle separation, generous spacing, SF-like typography. No gaudy rainbow reflections. LEFT screen: slim Telegram app chrome MAJLIS, brand majlis. and a small circular moon theme button; title "Мои заказы"; compact summary "2 в работе"; native-looking search pill "Найти заказ"; three small filter chips "Все" "В пути" "Получены"; two stacked refined order rows with subtle product thumbnail, "MJ-1044", "MacBook Pro 14", badge "В пути в Россию", "Подробнее"; second row "MJ-1045", "iPhone", badge "Товар закуплен". One featured order card may be taller with compact 7-step progress segments, no giant empty hero. Bottom floating frosted dock "Заказы" "Каталог" "Помощь" with clean line icons and blue selected pill. RIGHT screen: detail sheet full height with back chevron, "Заказ MJ-1044", same moon button, product "MacBook Pro 14"; restrained blue status panel "В пути в Россию"; vertical timeline of four labeled steps "Заказ подтверждён" "Товар закуплен" "В пути в Россию" "На складе", current step blue, future step subdued. Info row "Дата поставки уточняется". Compact section "Оплата" with explanatory "Статус не подтверждён" and blue rounded action "Связаться с магазином". Deliberately readable text, deliberate professional hierarchy, flat UI mockup quality as if designed in Figma. Preserve practical Mini App controls and high contrast. Do not invent maps, live location or confirmed payments. No manager role switch visible to buyer. All Cyrillic typography clean and exact. Render two screen panels completely within the board.
